limitations: Four new development cells only; 16 of48 comparisons completed, remaining32 matrix cells and held-out scope open.

Local null falsely targets one fact for seven selectors; confirmations are not stale-value corrections.
Lower changed fact corrected at358 in all nine; own/sham goal431 versus swapped/no-U/hand-authored430, with no own-U timing/task benefit.
Source acquisition is explicitly privileged manual supervision; continuations are actual fixed CPU FLYNN policy.act.
No biological-learning, operator-blindness, held-out or R2-completion claim.
